title: This Animal Runs 35 MPH for Four Miles Without Stopping

scenes.text: This animal runs 35 miles an hour for four miles straight.
It is a pronghorn, the fastest land mammal over long distances.
Over two miles, it has been clocked at 40 to 45 miles an hour.
Most animals tire long before that.
The pronghorn lives in North America, and it just keeps running.
Four miles at 35. Then it runs some more.

description:
A pronghorn has been observed running 35 miles an hour for 4.1 miles, a record for a sustained speed on land.
Over shorter distances it has hit even higher speeds.
Would you have guessed it?
first_comment: Could you outrun a pronghorn over four miles? Not a chance.
